title: Parts (iii),(iv): third-order Bernoulli/Euler supercongruences cited, not proved

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** Section 6, Theorem `thm:iiiiv` and items (R0)–(R3) ("these are supercongruences of Z.-W. Sun ... beyond a short self-contained treatment").

**Gap.** Parts (iii) and (iv) of the problem are NOT proved. The third-order congruences
$$\Sigma_a\equiv p^a\bigl(1+\tfrac76 p^3 B_{p-3}\bigr)\pmod{p^{a+3}},\qquad \sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\tfrac{(3k+1)\binom{2k}{k}^3}{16^k}\equiv p+2\bigl(\tfrac{-1}{p}\bigr)p^3E_{p-3}\pmod{p^4}$$
are stated and only verified numerically; the supplied (R0)–(R3) are correct consistency checks and a sketch (the $\Gamma_p$/WZ skeleton, the Glaisher congruence $\sum_{k=1}^{(p-1)/2}k^{-3}\equiv-2B_{p-3}\pmod p$), but no derivation of the cubic coefficients $\tfrac76 B_{p-3}$ and $2(\tfrac{-1}{p})E_{p-3}$ is given.

**What must be proved.** Derive the $p^3$ correction terms. Route: write $\binom{2k}{k}/16^k=\Gamma_p(\tfrac12+k)/(\Gamma_p(\tfrac12)k!)\cdot u_k$, expand $\log\Gamma_p$ to third order, and use the Glaisher congruence and its odd analogue (which produces $E_{p-3}$) to pin the constants $7/6$ and $2$. The $a\ge2$ case of (iii) additionally needs a Dwork-type lift across $p$-power truncations. Numerics confirm (iii) ($a=1$) and (iv) are TRUE mod $p^4$ for $7\le p\le 23$.
